newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Bucaram wants to castrate child rapists.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Bucaram wants to castrate child rapists.

text.p: Ecuador's populist new President Abdala Bucaram, frustrated by the Catholic Church's refusal to let him execute child rapists, is preparing a bill to have the rapists castrated, Bucaram's top aide said on Monday.
"There is no commandment that says 'Thou shalt not castrate'," said Administration Secretary Miguel Salem.
Bucaram will ask parliament for special powers to "render all child rapists impotent, whether by castration or chemical means," Salem told a news conference.
Bucaram's campaign to bring back the death penalty for murder and child rape was derailed after meeting strong church resistance earlier this month.
He made the proposal after being incensed by a case where a 10-year-old boy was raped, tortured and his body burned.
Under current Ecuadorean law, the maximum punishment for the boy's attackers would be 16 years in jail.
